name: Dev makefile
pitch: Create a makefile with common dev tasks for a new project.
instructions: First, list the files in the current directory. If a makefile already exists, read it and tell the person what is there, then stop. If no makefile exists, create a new file named Makefile. Write a default target that prints a help message listing the available tasks. Add four targets: build, test, lint, and deploy. Each target should run a simple echo command describing what the task does. After writing the file, read it back and show the contents to the person.

examples.does: list files, create Makefile with build, test, lint, deploy targets, and show the result

readme:
## dev makefile
Creates a Makefile with common dev tasks.

Needs: file_list, file_read, file_write.

Will not run any commands or open external sites.
